## Severity

8/10 — high availability risk

## Finding

A small request may select 720 rays and a 5,000-meter radius. With 25-meter segments, the simulation can produce roughly 144,000 GeoJSON features, each carrying coordinates and properties.

data.title: [Severity 9] Protect public RF routes from global compute starvation

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

data.body:
## Severity

9/10 — high-impact denial of service

## Finding

Expensive simulation, optimization, interference, and recommendation routes are unauthenticated and have no per-client rate budget. The only control is a global semaphore with a default capacity of two.

A client can continuously occupy both slots and cause all legitimate work to receive 429 responses. There is no explicit computation deadline around handlers, and cancellation is not checked inside the deepest ray/geometry loops.

The normal frontend workflow also starts simulation and coverage-gap work concurrently, consuming both default slots for one user.

## Evidence

- [Public RF routes](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/main.go#L106-L193)
- [Global two-slot limiter](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/main.go#L423-L442)
- [Optimization sweeps](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/static_simulation.go#L401-L455)
- [Recommendation evaluations](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/recommendation.go#L151-L265)
- [Inner simulation loop](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/static_simulation.go#L976-L1156)
- [Concurrent frontend requests](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/frontend-react/src/App.jsx#L329-L335)

data.title: [Severity 10] Prevent multi-gigabyte JSON amplification from tower IDs

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

data.body:
## Severity

10/10 — critical availability vulnerability

## Finding

Measurement and interference tower IDs have no length bound. A request below the global 1 MiB body limit can place a very large ID into a tower, and the backend repeats that ID in every response feature.

At the maximum sample counts, the measurement response can contain at least 3.86 GiB of repeated ID content and the interference response at least 2.93 GiB, before normal JSON overhead. Gin materializes the JSON result in memory, so an unauthenticated request can terminate the process through OOM or container eviction.

## Evidence

- [Tower request inputs](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/request_inputs.go#L17-L39)
- [Measurement sample limit](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/measurements.go#L148-L150)
- [Measurement serving-cell assignment](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/measurements.go#L228-L253)
- [Interference grid limits](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/interference.go#L338-L358)
- [Interference serving-cell assignment](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/interference.go#L471-L549)
- [Global request cap](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/main.go#L20)

No remediation has been applied; this issue tracks the audit finding.

data.title: [Severity 7] Update scanner-reachable vulnerable x/net dependency

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

data.body:
## Severity

7/10 — known vulnerable dependency with conditional exploitability

## Finding

The backend pins golang.org/x/net v0.25.0. govulncheck identified reachable call chains for:

- GO-2026-4918: HTTP/2 infinite loop on an invalid SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE; fixed in v0.53.0.
- GO-2026-5026: incorrect IDNA/Punycode handling; fixed in v0.55.0.
- GO-2025-3595: incorrect HTML tokenizer parsing; fixed in v0.38.0.

labels.description: New feature or request

data.body:
## Severity

4/10 — testing and toolchain compatibility risk

## Finding

Ordinary tests pass, but both go test -race ./... and coverage mode fail before test execution under Go 1.26.3 with package lookup errors for the bare module paths ankara-5g-raytracer and atom-core-lab-adapter.

CI derives Go 1.22 from go.mod, so this forward-compatibility failure remains hidden while the repository also stays on an unsupported Go line.

## Evidence

- [Backend module path](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/go.mod#L1-L3)
- [Adapter module path](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/core-lab-adapter/go.mod#L1-L3)
- [CI Go version selection](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml#L27-L44)

Reproduced on Go 1.26.3 darwin/arm64. No remediation has been applied.

data.title: [Severity 4] Remove RF wrappers that silently discard errors

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

data.body:
## Severity

4/10 — API redundancy and silent-failure risk

## Finding

Several convenience RF functions invoke context-aware implementations with context.Background() and discard returned errors.

This duplicates the API surface and lets future callers silently receive zero or partial results instead of propagating cancellation and computation failures.

## Evidence

- [Simulation wrapper](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/static_simulation.go#L225-L228)
- [Network wrapper examples](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/static_simulation.go#L395-L399)
- [Interference wrapper](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/backend-go/raytracer/interference.go#L275-L277)

No remediation has been applied.

data.title: [Severity 4] Consolidate report escaping and formatting helpers

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

data.body:
## Severity

4/10 — security-sensitive utility duplication

## Finding

HTML escaping, numeric formatting, markdown formatting, and report table construction are independently implemented in the general and interference report modules.

Because escaping is security-sensitive, these copies can diverge and leave one export path less safe than the other.

## Evidence

- [General report exporter](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/frontend-react/src/utils/reportExport.js)
- [Interference report exporter](https://github.com/Berk-Unsal/atom/blob/main/frontend-react/src/utils/interferenceReport.js)

No remediation has been applied.
